text:
Hello! I'm John, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer — its files, its accounts and its network are mine to use for you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram; each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **Own accounts online** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs and more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
On it — CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Checking the official schedule and the TAs' availability, then I'll book a slot.

Done — CSE455 staff meeting set for **Tuesday 15:00-15:30**.

Why that slot: Sarah, John and I are all free then, Wed 10:00-10:30 collides with the official CSE455 office hours and Wed 13:00-13:30 with a quiz section, so Tuesday was the only clash-free common window. Half an hour, as the TAs had no longer windows before Thursday, and Thursday/Friday are packed on my side too.

Calendar updated and logged (BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Sarah, John, Priya); all three TAs informed.
